subject: AWS engagement intro request — AstraMed imaging pilot
messages:
From: Emily Jones <emily.jones@astramed.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: it@astramed.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: AWS engagement for imaging pilot

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at AstraMed liked the latency/cost profile you presented for inference on imaging pipelines. Our CTO asked if we could put Redwood in touch with the AWS partner manager for our account to explore a joint engagement (co-sell + marketplace listing options).

High level ask: can you make a warm intro to AWS and help sketch a joint account plan / next steps for a small pilot (3 months, single-region, PHI-scope controls)? We want to understand what qualifies for an AWS co-sell, any marketplace listing implications, and a recommended mutual action plan.

A few constraints:
- Pilot needs to run in us-east-1 (regulatory).
- We require SOC2 evidence and a basic data flow diagram before kicking off.

If you prefer, we can put together a short internal doc describing the pilot.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Jones
Head of Data Science
AstraMed

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@astramed.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: AWS engagement for imaging pilot

Emily —

Great to hear the demo landed well. Happy to coordinate the intro to AWS and draft a mutual action plan. I'm looping in Vanessa (Marketplace/Partners lead) and Karthik (AWS co-sell / sales lead) so we can get the right people on the call.

Quick proposed next steps:
1) Warm intro to AWS partner manager (Vanessa can make the connection; she maintains our AWS partner contacts).
2) Draft a 1-page mutual action plan (I have a template) — I attached a starter M.A.P. and a one-pager about Redwood's imaging runtime.
3) Quick kickoff call (30 min) to align on scope, timelines, and what AWS needs to qualify the co-sell.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_draft.xlsx; redwood-image-pipeline-brief.pdf

Are you available for a kickoff on Thursday 20 May between 10:00-11:30 PT or Friday 21 May 09:00-11:00 PT?

I'll also flag the SOC2 and data-flow ask so we can pull the right evidence.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@astramed.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Michael Lee <michael.lee@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Intro: AWS engagement for imaging pilot

Hi Emily, Rishi —

Thanks for the loop. Emily, introducing Michael Lee (AWS Partner Manager) — Michael, meet Emily Jones, Head of Data Science at AstraMed; they're evaluating Redwood for an imaging inference pilot and are interested in AWS co-sell/marketplace options.

Michael — quick context for the call:
- AstraMed wants a 3-month pilot in us-east-1 with PHI protections.
- They need SOC2 evidence and a data flow diagram before kickoff.
- Potential outcomes: co-sell enablement + marketplace listing if pilot succeeds.

Suggested agenda for a 30-minute kickoff (we can adjust):
- 5m intros and goals
- 10m AstraMed use case & constraints (PHI, region)
- 10m co-sell qualification and marketplace checklist (AWS)
- 5m next steps / ownership (mutual action plan owners)

I've pasted a draft MAP link here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AstraPlan. Rishi attached a starter MAP as well.

Available times (PT): Thu 20 May 10:30-11:00, Fri 21 May 09:30-10:00, Fri 21 May 10:30-11:00. Michael, can you confirm what works on your side?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships & Marketplace
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Michael Lee <michael.lee@amazon.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Emily Jones <emily.jones@astramed.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: AWS engagement for imaging pilot

Hi all —

Thanks for the intro, Vanessa. Happy to join a short kickoff. Fri 21 May 09:30 PT works for me — I can do 09:30-10:00.

A few notes so we use the time efficiently:
- AWS co-sell qualification: I will need a brief description of the joint solution, a clear customer contact, and expected ARR if we scale beyond pilot. For pilots, AWS sometimes uses a marketplace ‘pilot program’ route; we can discuss which path fits AstraMed.
- Regarding compliance evidence: share SOC2 report and a redacted data flow diagram (no PHI in the diagram) and we can route to AWS security for initial review.

I'll join the call and can cover the co-sell checklist. If the call needs a deeper dive on marketplace listing ops, we can schedule a follow-up with the marketplace onboarding team.

Meeting confirmed: Fri 21 May 09:30 PT / 12:30 ET. I'll send a calendar invite.

Regards,
Michael Lee
Senior Partner Manager, Healthcare
Amazon Web Services

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Jones <emily.jones@astramed.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Michael Lee <michael.lee@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: AWS engagement for imaging pilot

Thanks everyone — quick note before the kickoff:
- Emily: we'll send the SOC2 snapshot and a redacted data flow diagram to you and Michael by EOD today.
- Rishi & Vanessa: I've updated the mutual_action_plan_draft.xlsx with owners and a proposed timeline (rows highlighted). Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AstraPlan
- Action owners on the call: Redwood (Rishi) to own pilot delivery timelines; AstraMed (Emily) to own access & sample data provisioning (redacted); AWS (Michael) to own co-sell qualification guidance and introduce marketplace onboarding if needed.

See you on the call at 09:30 PT.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
